body: Chief: P0-2 phase-1 candidate 9ae15cb is BLOCKED (fresh-context review with probes; my archive run embed-core 48/48 JVM+JS agrees the tests pass — the block is about what the type permits). HIGH-1: Plain is constructible for ANY material from outside the package — enum ReceiptDigest { case Plain(checksum) } (receipt.scala:25-27) and CacheKey (cache.scala:12) are public and EmbeddingReceipt.of (receipt.scala:112-131) takes items with no sensitivity evidence; probe: ReceiptDigest.Plain(Checksum.ofText(sensitiveText)) → CacheKey renders it and EmbeddingReceipt.of returns Right(kind=Plain, isKeyConsistent=true). 'Sensitive+Plain unconstructible by type' currently lives only inside ReceiptDigest.of. Fix: sealed trait/final classes with private[embed] constructors (enum cases cannot hide theirs), CacheKey private[embed], construction only via of/keyed/fromMaterial; same for MaterialDigest.Plain (digest.scala:95) or the bridge reopens the hole. HIGH-2: Plain fallback reachable on the provider-call surface — baselines.scala:72-76 falls back to Plain('keyed-outputs-unavailable') and :89-97 to a Plain zero-item receipt via .toOption.get (:96) when ReceiptDigest.keyed fails after items were keyed; probe (key available once): outcome Right with sensitive text embedded, receipt kind=Plain, no PolicyDecision. Fix: fail the batch closed with typed Invalid(InvalidKey) outcomes + recorded decision; remove both getOrElse/get paths. MEDIUM-3: missing key yields EmbedError.InvalidKey → ExecutionFailure.Invalid, not the accepted PolicyDenied(NoKey), and no PolicyDecision is recorded (baselines.scala:54-56, cache.scala:81) — acceptable only as an explicitly noted phase-2 deferral, stated in the commit and the bead. MEDIUM-4: Keyed(digest, keyId) duplicates the key id (receipt.scala:27) — probe Keyed(d_k1, 'k9') renders hmac:k1 but writes digest-key-id=k9 into params; drop the field, derive from digest.keyId. LOW-5: the golden vector's rendering receipt/v1|… (digest.scala:62-63) is not any production HMAC input (production: Material.render at cache.scala:43 — still literal NUL bytes, replace with escapes as P0-1 did — and id=render\n at receipt.scala:123); ADR 0001 D6 must specify the canonical rendering (my addition 3) and the golden must hash the production rendering. LOW-6: typed kind reachable only via LocalBaseline.embedWithReceipt; Embedder.embed/CachingEmbedder drop it — fine if stated as phase 2 on the bead. Verified OK: HMAC-SHA256/RFC 2104 over UTF-8; provider-call checksums are hash-of-rendered-HMAC for keyed batches; canary law covers renders/hexes/params; CachingEmbedder bypasses and never caches without a key. Repost the candidate when done; same re-review.
